Path: changing a running app without code | studio-authoring.custom-page-render-and-blocks (its steps hold no `dashboard` block on a page) | P1

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-dashboard` (`DashboardRenderer` / `DatasetWidget`, the adapter source) ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: a `dashboard` block is holdable on a stored page, since `PageComponentSchema.type` admits any registered key. On the page path its dataset-bound widgets issue zero queries and paint 「This data source does not support dataset queries.」, although the page's `useSchemaContext` holds a capable adapter. The dev's probe measured this through the real `SchemaRenderer`; the served page was not measured. Checklist state ②: `studio-authoring.custom-page-render-and-blocks` (P2) asserts that each declared block binds its data source, and its steps reach no `dashboard` block ⇒ inherit ⇒ **p2**.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T17:22Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), objectui#10778 and PR objectui#10809 (open; it touches `ObjectDataTable` / `ObjectPivotTable` in the same package, not these files).

**Not a blocker of objectui#10519.** As the card says, these widgets load nothing on the page path today, so removing the remount cannot make them staler. No serial constraint: the files are disjoint from PR objectui#10809. Reuse its reader shape.

**Execution notes.**
1. Fall back to the ambient `useSchemaContext` data source when no `dataSource` prop is given, the way the page-embeddable object blocks take theirs. The visible no-adapter alert stays for a host that really has no adapter, which is the CHANGELOG's deliberate state.
2. In the same PR, the dataset widgets take the bus reader (the objectui#10778 shape).
3. Pin a `dashboard` block with a dataset widget on the page path: data renders, and a re-read follows `notifyDataChanged`. A host with no adapter still shows the alert (the control).

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`: the `queryDataset` effect (line ~608) takes the `useDataInvalidation` bus reader (the objectui#10778 shape);
- tests beside them; one `.changeset/10815-…md` (`patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`).
⛔ Not `ObjectDataTable.tsx` / `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` (PR objectui#10819, this seat). ⛔ Not `DrillDownDrawer.tsx` (objectui#10814, this seat). ⛔ Not `DashboardFilterBar.tsx` (objectui#10799, this seat). ⛔ Not the package `README.md` (PR objectui#10714). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12534` on objectstack `17bd3187`; `--tier` refuses objectui paths).
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5858065473
Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-27T17:52Z at objectui `origin/main` `9a5f998` (15 open PRs): in `packages/plugin-dashboard`, only PR objectui#10819 (`ObjectDataTable.tsx`, `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx`, tests) and PR objectui#10714 (the `README.md`) are open. Both are disjoint files. PR objectui#10809 merged as `8c3d7fc`. No in-flight claim declares these two files.

`Clause-②: no`: a block that already accepts `dataSource` takes the page's adapter when no prop is passed. The visible no-adapter alert stays for a host with none. No declared key, export or accept set moves.
